_comment: Sample PostToolUse hook for the digital-twin pushback detector. Append the entries under `hooks` to your own ~/.claude/settings.json. The detector is incremental and idempotent — running on every assistant turn is cheap (only new bytes are read).
_install_notes: 1. Replace ~/code/digital-twin with the path where you cloned/installed the plugin.
2. The `|| true` suppresses any non-zero exit so the hook never blocks your workflow.
3. Run `/digital-twin:propose-rules` weekly to review what the detector found.
